condition: A CSS border shorthand that uses certain named colors (e.g. indigo, aqua, linen, mintcream, turquoise) is misparsed as a size, so Styler.to_excel exports the border as black with zero width.
workaround: Write the color as a hex code (e.g. #4B0082), or use separate longhand properties such as border-color, border-style and border-width instead of the shorthand.
